neighbours.label: the standalone space token that the tokenizer splits off before a digit string (' 2013' -> ' ' + digits), in dates, code and prose alike; text where no space precedes a digit stays low
fire: The festival was first held in the town square on May 9, 1987, and has run every year since.
According to the census, the village had 312 residents and two schools.
The bridge, completed in 1932, still carries most of the traffic into the city.
She ran the marathon in just under 3 hours and finished in the top ten.
The library received a donation of 850 books from a retired professor.
Le musée a ouvert ses portes le 12 mars 2004 après des années de travaux.
The recipe serves 6 people and takes about an hour to prepare.
quiet: The festival was first held in the town square in late spring and has run every year since.
According to the census, the village had several hundred residents and two schools.
The bridge, completed long ago, still carries most of the traffic into the city.
She ran the marathon in just under three hours and finished in the top ten.
The library received a large donation of books from a retired professor.
Le musée a ouvert ses portes au printemps après des années de travaux.
The recipe serves a family of six and takes about an hour to prepare.

notes: Card: 16 of the top 32 peak on the bare ' ' token before a year or number. Probe: the space before a digit fired 0.174-0.206 in dates ('June 3, 2015' 0.176), code ('>= 0' 0.174, '[1.0, ...' 0.206), prose ('bought 2013 shares' 0.189, '45 people' 0.194) and French ('4 juillet 1998' 0.187); a sentence with no digits 0.046. Near misses write numbers as words or attach digits to brackets/hyphens so no ' ' token precedes them.
